items.question: Does MediClear give medical advice?
items.answer: No. MediClear only translates your reports into plain language and is for informational purposes only. It never substitutes for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always review your results with a physician.

items.question: What types of reports can I analyze?
items.answer: You can analyze blood tests, radiology (X-ray, MRI, CT), pathology, cardiology (ECG, echo), hormone tests and general medical reports.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your reports are processed only for analysis and are not permanently stored on our servers. Once the analysis is complete, your file is not retained.

items.question: Which file formats can I upload?
items.answer: You can upload PDF, JPG, PNG and WebP files. The maximum file size is 20 MB.

items.question: How long does an analysis take?
items.answer: Most analyses finish within seconds. Complex or multi-page reports may take a little longer.

items.question: How many analyses do I get on the free plan?
items.answer: The free plan includes a total of 2 analyses. Upgrade to Premium for more.

items.question: What does Premium offer?
items.answer: Premium gives you 10 analyses per month, priority processing, PDF saving and sharing, and unlimited history access. $4.99 per month.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel anytime. After cancellation you keep Premium features until the end of the billing period.

items.question: What if I pick the wrong category?
items.answer: MediClear checks the type of document you upload. If it doesn't match your chosen category, it warns you and asks you to select the correct one.

items.question: Can I trust the results?
items.answer: MediClear uses powerful AI, but AI can make mistakes. Treat the results as a starting point and always consult a healthcare professional.

Information obtained through the application is not an alternative to consulting your doctor or other qualified healthcare professionals.
